reply:
UPDATE: `async/await` runs on the main thread and doesn't yield CPU during heavy computation. Freezing happens because the event loop is blocked.

To unfreeze the UI, use a Web Worker to move the CPU work off the main thread entirely. Alternatively, break the work into chunks with `setTimeout(..., 0)` between them to yield back to the event loop and let the browser repaint/handle input.

grade.note: Reply concedes async runs on main thread and correctly recommends Web Worker/chunking, matching developer and ground truth.
